feats.title: Cyclone Spirit
feats.description: Whenever you or an ally pulls, pushes, or slides a target, the distance of the forced movement can be increased by 1 square if the target began the forced movement adjacent to your spirit companion.

feats.title: Elemental Spirit Adept
feats.description: When your spirit companion disappears as a result of one of your Shaman attack powers, you and your allies gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls against any enemy that was adjacent to the spirit. The bonus lasts until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Ephemeral Spirit
feats.description: When your spirit companion disappears as a result of a ranged attack, you take half the normal damage from its destruction.

feats.title: Nimble Spirit
feats.description: You can use Call Spirit Companion as a free action during your turn.

feats.title: Spirit's Eyes
feats.description: Whenever you make a Perception check while your spirit companion is present, you can roll twice and use either result.

feats.title: Vicious Spirit
feats.description: When you use Healing Spirit, each ally adjacent to your spirit companion gains a +2 bonus to damage rolls against bloodied enemies until the end of your next turn.
